scripts.dev: bun run --filter '@pier/daemon' dev & bun run --filter '@pier/web' dev
scripts.build: bun run --filter '@pier/web' build && bun run --filter '@pier/daemon' build
scripts.e2e: bun run build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test
